_readme: Recorded result sets for OFFLINE_MODE=1. execute_sql runs the FULL AST policy first and
only then replaces the database driver with a lookup in this file, so offline runs
enforce exactly the same policy as online runs.
Keys are matched on whitespace/case-normalised SQL. Both the raw query and the
policy-rewritten form (LIMIT injected/clamped) are stored: the agent executes the
rewritten form, the eval harness executes raw gold SQL.
Regenerate after changing db/seed.py, db/schema.sql, the gold SQL or the LLM script:
then re-run the recording snippet documented in docs/DECISIONS.md

results.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-06-01' AND p.paid_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT r.region_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-04-01' AND p.paid_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT r.region_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments AS p JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-04-01' AND p.paid_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT pr.product_id, pr.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2027-01-01' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY pr.product_id, pr.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, pr.product_name ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE r.region_code = 'SOUTH' AND c.status = 'active'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE r.region_code = 'SOUTH' AND c.status = 'active' LIMIT 1000

SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' AND o.created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.created_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY cancelled_orders DESC, o.channel ASC
